items.headline: Senator Elizabeth Warren Calls for Breakup of Major Healthcare Conglomerates
items.summary: Senator Elizabeth Warren has publicly advocated for the structural breakup of large healthcare conglomerates, specifically naming CVS Health Corporation as a target for such action.

items.headline: BlackRock's HPS Investment Partners Begins Marketing New Direct-Lending Fund
items.summary: HPS Investment Partners, a firm associated with BlackRock, has initiated the marketing phase for a new direct-lending investment fund.

items.headline: BlackRock Canada Announces November 2026 Cash Distributions for iShares ETFs
items.summary: BlackRock Asset Management Canada Limited has declared the November 2026 cash distributions for its suite of iShares ETFs.

items.headline: Genomics Ltd. Extends Strategic Drug Discovery Collaboration with Vertex Pharmaceuticals
items.summary: Vertex Pharmaceuticals and Genomics Ltd. have extended their long-standing drug discovery and validation partnership for an additional four years.

items.headline: NVIDIA Establishes Export Control Committee and Delays 10-Q Filing
items.summary: NVIDIA has formed a new oversight committee for national security and export controls while delaying its quarterly 10-Q filing.

items.headline: Jeff Bezos Discusses Casting Process for New James Bond Film
items.summary: Amazon executive chairman Jeff Bezos provided insights into the casting of Robert Pattinson as the next James Bond, confirming the role of Amazon MGM Studios in the selection process.

items.headline: StackGen Launches Shipyard on Microsoft Marketplace
items.summary: StackGen has made its Shipyard platform available on the Microsoft Marketplace, enabling Azure customers to deploy ephemeral test environments for AI agents and developers.

items.headline: Transamerica Expands AI Partnership with Amazon Web Services
items.summary: Transamerica has deepened its collaboration with Amazon Web Services to scale artificial intelligence across its enterprise operations.

items.headline: BlackRock, Inc. Files Disclosure of Voting Rights in ICG PLC
items.summary: BlackRock, Inc. reported an acquisition or disposal of voting rights in ICG PLC, a UK-based issuer, with the threshold crossed on November 13, 2026.

items.headline: Teamsters Rally Following Amazon's Termination of Delivery Partner
items.summary: The International Brotherhood of Teamsters held a rally in Manhattan to protest the firing of approximately 200 delivery drivers following Amazon's cancellation of a contract with a delivery service p

items.headline: NVIDIA Reports Financial Results for Third Quarter Fiscal 2027
items.summary: NVIDIA announced its financial results for the third quarter of fiscal 2027, reporting revenue of $115.8 billion, a 103% increase year-over-year.

items.headline: Generation Life Launches ConfidencePlus Annuity with BlackRock Alliance
items.summary: Generation Life has introduced an investment-linked lifetime annuity product, ConfidencePlus, developed in partnership with BlackRock.

items.headline: Broadcom to Invest $1 Billion in Anthropic IPO
items.summary: Broadcom has agreed to invest $1 billion in Anthropic's initial public offering as part of a strategic commitment involving major technology suppliers.

items.headline: Microsoft Launches AI Transparency Initiative
items.summary: Microsoft has introduced an AI Transparency Initiative aimed at establishing common standards for security, governance, and transparency in artificial intelligence models.

items.headline: Rockwell Automation Launches GPU-Enabled Industrial Computing with NVIDIA
items.summary: Rockwell Automation has introduced new industrial computing solutions powered by NVIDIA accelerated computing to enhance edge AI capabilities.

items.headline: Marvell Technology CEO Matthew J. Murphy Sells Shares
items.summary: Marvell Technology, Inc. CEO and Chairman Matthew J. Murphy sold 7,500 shares of company stock on November 16, 2026, according to a recent SEC filing.

items.headline: Meta Platforms COO Javier Olivan Sells Shares Worth Over $1 Million
items.summary: Meta Platforms Chief Operating Officer Javier Olivan sold 1,568 shares of company stock, according to a recent SEC Form 4 filing.

items.headline: Baird Adjusts Price Target on Qualcomm
items.summary: Baird has revised its price target for Qualcomm, lowering it from $320 to $300.

items.headline: Wells Fargo Adjusts Price Target on Steel Dynamics to $285 From $271
items.summary: Wells Fargo has updated its price target for Steel Dynamics, Inc., increasing it from $271 to $285.

items.headline: Wells Fargo Adjusts Price Target on Procter & Gamble to $188 From $180
items.summary: Wells Fargo has updated its price target for The Procter & Gamble Company, increasing it from $180 to $188.

items.headline: Morgan Stanley Adjusts Price Target on EOG Resources to $167 From $163
items.summary: Morgan Stanley has updated its price target for EOG Resources, raising it to $167 from the previous $163.

items.headline: RBC Raises Price Target on Imperial Oil to CA$138 From CA$133
items.summary: RBC has increased its price target for Imperial Oil Limited, reflecting a positive adjustment in the firm's outlook for the company.

items.headline: South Korean Regulator Orders Apple to Designate Legal Representatives
items.summary: South Korean regulators have ordered Apple and several other major technology companies to appoint local legal representatives by January following a rise in customer complaints.

items.headline: Apple Updates Operating System to Restrict Accessibility Tool Usage
items.summary: Apple has implemented an operating system update that restricts the use of accessibility tools on Macs to prevent potential data privacy risks.

items.headline: Nike Targets 50% Local Product Creation in China by Fiscal 2030
items.summary: Nike announced a new initiative to design and create half of its sportswear products locally in China by fiscal 2030.

items.headline: Wells Fargo Adjusts Price Target on Nucor to $308 From $305
items.summary: Wells Fargo has updated its price target for Nucor Corporation, increasing it from $305 to $308.

items.headline: Barclays Adjusts Price Target on The Walt Disney Company
items.summary: Barclays has updated its financial outlook for The Walt Disney Company, raising its price target from $115 to $135.

items.headline: Wolfe Research Initiates Coverage on Keurig Dr Pepper with Outperform Rating
items.summary: Wolfe Research has initiated coverage on Keurig Dr Pepper Inc. with an 'Outperform' rating.

items.headline: Analysts Adjust Price Targets for The Home Depot Following Quarterly Results
items.summary: Several financial institutions, including Bernstein, BNP Paribas, Truist, and Evercore ISI, updated their price targets for The Home Depot on November 18, 2026.

items.headline: BTIG Adjusts Price Target on Intuitive Surgical to $513 From $454
items.summary: BTIG has updated its price target for Intuitive Surgical, raising it to $513 from the previous target of $454.

items.headline: Lowe's Reports Q3 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: Lowe's Companies, Inc. reported third-quarter revenue of $22.76 billion and adjusted earnings per share of $3.10, both exceeding analyst expectations.

items.headline: GetBusy Expands SmartVault Integration with Intuit Applications
items.summary: GetBusy has announced an expansion of its SmartVault integration with Intuit's software ecosystem.

items.headline: BNP Paribas Adjusts Price Target on GE Vernova
items.summary: BNP Paribas has lowered its price target for GE Vernova Inc. from $1,090 to $797.

items.headline: Palantir Technologies Director Executes Stock Sale
items.summary: Palantir Technologies director Alexander D. Moore sold 16,000 shares of company stock for approximately $2.69 million, according to a recent SEC filing.

items.headline: Morgan Stanley Adjusts Price Target and Rating on ConocoPhillips
items.summary: Morgan Stanley has updated its outlook on ConocoPhillips, adjusting the price target to $160 from $159 and shifting its rating to Neutral.

items.headline: Alphabet's Waymo Suspends Freeway Driving Following Regulatory Restrictions
items.summary: Waymo has suspended its autonomous freeway operations across the United States following new restrictions imposed by the California Department of Motor Vehicles.

items.headline: Citigroup Adjusts Price Target on Ecolab to $365 From $345
items.summary: Citigroup has revised its price target for Ecolab Inc., increasing it from $345 to $365.

items.headline: Gilead Sciences Insider Sells Shares Worth Over $4.7 Million
items.summary: A recent SEC filing reveals that Johanna Mercier, Chief Commercial Officer at Gilead Sciences, sold 28,000 shares of company stock.

items.headline: Bernstein Maintains Outperform Rating on Lam Research
items.summary: Bernstein reaffirmed its "Outperform" rating and $350 price target for Lam Research, citing the company's strong execution and potential market opportunities in advanced chip technologies.
